shared_elements: human figures in profile with patterned/curled hair and beards
figures shown standing, full-length, in a single register
hands extended forward holding small objects
long-handled implement / staff-like object held at the side
repeated figures at uniform scale along a horizontal frieze
low-relief carving with incised interior detail (hair, garment, fringe)
justification: Both surfaces depict full-length human figures in strict profile, uniform in scale along a single horizontal register, with elaborately patterned coiffures and beards, extended hands grasping small objects, and a staff-like implement held at the side — a fairly specific shared figural convention. The biggest difference in content is that A shows a procession of scantily clad figures driving horned rams past a conifer-like tree between ornamental rosette borders, whereas B shows long-robed figures confronting one another in pairs with no animals, plant or border motifs.
